How to write a better Instagram caption with AI: one-line prompt vs a 4-part brief

Same job, two prompts. The one-liner gave me "magical adventures" and five hashtags, but no day, no time, no age range and no mention that it's free.

The 4-part brief:

"WHO: [WHO IT'S FOR]
WHAT: [EVENT, DAY, TIME, COST]
VOICE: [3 WORDS], max 2 emojis
ACTION: [WHAT TO DO NEXT]
Write 3 caption options under 60 words. The first line must work on its own."

For an invented bookshop's free story time, it wrote: "Free story time is here! Every Saturday, 10 to 10:30am, starting Nov 7. Bring your 3 to 7 year old, grab a cushion, and we'll handle the dragons."

A few extra lines of typing, a caption people can act on.

Follow @nomorebusywork and comment PROMPTS: I'll DM you 25 free prompts for your business.
